title: ShadowResult
description: Ingest contract for POST /components/{component_id}/shadow-results: the payload the SDK's shadow thread sends after running the registered candidate on a snapshot of the inputs. The manual `evaluation` verdict (better/worse/same/unknown) is server-side state set later via PUT /shadow-results/{id}/evaluation and is not part of this event.

trace_id.description: trace_id of the production trace this shadow run belongs to.

component_id.description: Must match the component_id in the request path.

current_output.description: repr of the production (current) implementation's output.

candidate_output.description: repr of the candidate implementation's output; null when the candidate raised.

candidate_error.description: "ExceptionType: message" when the candidate raised; null on success.

projections.description: Projection extraction results for the shadow comparison (Issue #150). The SDK sends phases shadow_current (extracted in the caller's thread) and shadow_candidate (extracted in the shadow thread; omitted when the candidate raised); input/output phases are accepted for contract parity with the server model but normally arrive on the trace event.

error.description: Non-fatal extraction diagnostic; set when extraction failed and fields/metrics/samples are empty.
